integrity: Theorem is proved from the exact second-moment identity and finite-dimensional cone positivity; finite verification samples supplement, but do not replace, infinite quantifiers. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit harmonic oscillator, kick--drift symplectic Euler, iid steps strictly in (0,2); no correlated-step, other-integrator, or almost-sure exponent classification. The earliest day-resolved verified public source is the 1992-11-01 institutional publication record for Skeel and Gear; an earlier preprint has not been established. Potential equivalence to unlocated random matrix product literature remains.
title: Universal mean-square energy growth under random symplectic-Euler steps
